Deploys the contract, validates addresses and initializes time and deposit parameters.
ERC777 hook that records deposits; rejects wrong token, late deposits and sub-minimum deposits.
Manager-only one-time setter of the migration contract and infinite token approval.
Manager-only setter that forwards to _setMerkleRoot.

edges.reason: Constructor argument _manager is written into the manager state variable.
Constructor argument _depositToken is cast to IERC20 and stored in depositToken.
_timeUntilDepositsEnd is added to block.timestamp to derive depositEndTime.
_timeUntilWithdraw is added to block.timestamp to derive withdrawUnlockTime.
Constructor argument _minimumDeposit is stored in minimumDeposit.
Constructor derives deposit and withdraw deadlines from block.timestamp.
depositEndTime is computed from the block.timestamp of the deployment block.
withdrawUnlockTime is computed from the block.timestamp of the deployment block.
tokensReceived gates deposits on block.timestamp < depositEndTime, a timestamp dependency.
withdraw gates withdrawal on block.timestamp >= withdrawUnlockTime, a timestamp dependency.
msg.sender must equal the deposit token address, a caller-controlled authorization check.
msg.sender is the account credited and used for virtualBalance indexing without further authorization.
The caller identity is compared against manager inside the onlyManager modifier.
msg.sender indexes depositorBalance and is forwarded to the migration contract.
msg.sender indexes virtualBalance and is forwarded to the migration contract.
msg.sender indexes depositorBalance and is the recipient of the withdrawn tokens.
onlyManager guards setMigrationContract against non-manager callers.
onlyManager guards setMerkleRoot against non-manager callers.
_migrationContract parameter is converted to IAcceptsDeposit inside setMigrationContract.
Manager-controlled function writes the privileged migrationContract state variable.
setMigrationContract invokes getMigratorAddress to validate the migration contract.
setMigrationContract invokes approve to grant the migration contract an unlimited allowance.
Merkle root argument flows from setMerkleRoot into the internal setter.
setMerkleRoot delegates the write to _setMerkleRoot.
_setMerkleRoot writes the validated root into merkleRoot after a one-time check.
tokensReceived performs depositorBalance[from] += amount, an unchecked-pattern balance addition.
tokensReceived requires the resulting depositorBalance to be at least minimumDeposit.
The from parameter indexes and updates depositorBalance.
The amount parameter is added to depositorBalance and compared to minimumDeposit.
index parameter is forwarded from claimVirtualBalance into _claim.
amount parameter is forwarded into _claim and credited to virtualBalance.
merkleProof parameter is forwarded into _claim for verification.
claimVirtualBalance delegates proof verification and claiming to _claim.
claimVirtualBalance executes virtualBalance[msg.sender] += amount.
_claim reads and sets the claimed bit map to prevent double claiming.
_claim reads merkleRoot as the verification root.
_claim computes the leaf local variable from index, account and amount.
amount parameter is subtracted from depositorBalance and forwarded to the migration contract.
migrateDeposit performs depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount.
migrateDeposit makes an external call into the migration contract after updating state.
amount parameter is subtracted from virtualBalance and forwarded to the migration contract.
migrateVirtualBalance performs virtualBalance[msg.sender] -= amount.
migrateVirtualBalance makes an external call into the migration contract after updating state.
amount parameter is subtracted from depositorBalance and used for the token transfer.
withdraw performs depositorBalance[msg.sender] -= amount.
withdraw performs an external ERC777 transfer after decrementing the balance.
The ERC777 transfer hook can invoke tokensReceived on the recipient, enabling a cross-function reentrant deposit path.
A malicious token recipient could re-enter withdraw during the external transfer.
The migration contract could re-enter migrateDeposit while the external call is in flight.
The migration contract could re-enter migrateVirtualBalance while the external call is in flight.
